findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：2025年12月Gilead與政府達成協議，Section 232關稅對Gilead暫停三年，並含Medicaid MFN定價、Epclusa直接對患者價、海外營收回饋美國。
findings.excerpt: In December 2025, Gilead reached an agreement with the administration to (1) pause the imposition of Section 232 tariffs on Gilead for three years, (2) implement MFN prices in Medicaid for select existing and future launched products, (3) set a new direct-to-patient price for Epclusa and (4) return a portion of increased international revenues to the U.S. if the U.S. government is successful in increasing drug prices abroad.

findings.claim: 10-K：2025年9月政府宣布對進口品牌/專利藥課最高100%關稅（有例外），具體影響不確定；可能增加製造成本、影響供應鏈。
findings.excerpt: in September 2025, the U.S. Presidential administration announced plans to impose up to 100% tariffs on imported branded or patented pharmaceuticals, subject to certain exceptions. The specific impact remains uncertain at this time and is subject to the timing, scope and duration of any tariffs and actions imposed

findings.claim: 10-K：Gilead計畫至2030年在美國投資320億美元擴充製造與研發，面臨建廠延遲、成本膨脹等風險。
findings.excerpt: We are undertaking significant multi‑year capital investments to expand our U.S. manufacturing capabilities and accelerate R&D, including our initiative to invest $32 billion in the U.S. through 2030.

findings.claim: 2026年9月10-Q稱關稅長期影響不確定，且即使目前符合豁免也不保證未來不適用；提及2026年7月生效的全球Section 301關稅。
findings.excerpt: and trade actions both within and outside the pharmaceutical industry, including the global Section 301 tariffs that took effect in July 2026 as well as potential tariffs from other ongoing investigations. Even if it is determined that Gilead currently qualifies for an exemption, there can be no assurance that these or other tariffs will not apply to us in the future.
